payload.text: (hv, 2026-11-19, by selection in the question dialog in vc's session, answered by 11:21Z on vc's date -u; the questions' and options' wording is vc's, each choice is hv's) THREE RULINGS, AND ST0096 NOT YET REVIEWED. (1) ST0095: IN A PROJECT NOT YET UPGRADED, THE FIRST MINT REFUSES, with intent upgrade as its one remedy (cc's meaning; vc's recommendation). hv chose "Refuse, name the upgrade (Recommended)" over a mint that runs the upgrade itself. (2) ST0095: THE 00046 BEND IS ACCEPTED: a token of only digits, 5 or more long, is a hash prefix, so an over-padded ordinal stops resolving, while 46, 0046, ST46, ST0046, s46 and i21 keep their meaning (vc's recommendation). (3) ST0096: TWO MERGE REQUESTS THAT CHANGE THE SAME THREAD ARE CLOSED BY CONSTRUCTION IN THIS RELEASE, against vc's recommendation. The option hv chose, "Close it in this release", read: "Adds an L to XL package to cc's chain, which delays the release." Its question said that closing it needs a canon file per work package, criterion and test, and a rewrite of the thread views. On ST0096 as a whole, asked whether to accept its design as written, hv answered, verbatim: "What? Why? What is going on here? I'm a bit lost. This needs more explanation." So ST0096 is not accepted, and nothing in it starts until vc has explained it and hv says go.
